intent: Mike found Dad’s relay notebook on the passenger seat. The last complete entry listed several calls about women standing at open doors, and beneath it Dad had written only: “They all heard something.” The next line stopped halfway across the page. I have treated his order to keep the house as proof that I did the right thing, but the notebook makes me wonder whether he stayed because he had already recognized the beginning of the Plague.
emotion: grieving, reflective, and uncertain what obedience cost
communicationMedium: the room while looking at Dad's photograph
